scope: 395 persistence tests passed, including unit, integration, and documentation tests. Atomic filesystem tests cover phase ordering, injected phase failures, native creation and replacement, and temporary-file cleanup.
Nine session save tests passed, covering veto, failed final replacement, identity and package retention, dirty state, saved baseline, and undo/redo.
limitations: These selected tests do not establish all R2 exit requirements or the full workspace gate.
Native filesystem tests ran on Linux only; cross-platform replacement behavior was not tested.
Directory metadata durability after power loss is outside the atomic replacement contract.
